FROM node:24-bookworm-slim
ARG QMD_VERSION=latest
RUN apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends build-essential ca-certificates cmake curl python3 \
    && npm install --global "@tobilu/qmd@${QMD_VERSION}" \
    && npm cache clean --force \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* \
    && install -d -o node -g node /home/node/.config/qmd /home/node/.cache/qmd
USER node
WORKDIR /home/node
ENV HOME=/tmp/qmd-home QMD_CONFIG_DIR=/home/node/.config/qmd XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/home/node/.config XDG_CACHE_HOME=/home/node/.cache INDEX_PATH=/home/node/.cache/qmd/index.sqlite QMD_FORCE_CPU=1
EXPOSE 8181
CMD ["qmd", "mcp", "--http", "--host", "0.0.0.0", "--port", "8181"]
